name: Ginnami Yuzuru
source:
"When I look at you, ...I'm dazzled. It makes me feel strange."

A handsome young man who is the head of the surveillance division of "Rindou", commonly known as "Tanoshi". Due to the misfortunes that have befallen his family in the past, he is devoid of any emotions other than "fun." He is typically gentle and mild-mannered, but he is abnormally ruthless toward those who are obsessed with singing.

With his obsession for them, he stands out from the crowd as soon as he joins the agency and becomes the right-hand man of Sen. He loves his younger brother very much.

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/live/original/character/ginnami_yuzuru.html]official website[/url]]
